package task

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func normalizeTaskTestSourceKeys(tests []domain.TaskTest, expectedKinds ...string) error {
	expectedKind := domain.TaskTestKindSingleChoice
	if len(expectedKinds) > 0 {
		expectedKind = expectedKinds[0]
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
	for testIndex := range tests {
		if strings.TrimSpace(tests[testIndex].Kind) == "" {
			tests[testIndex].Kind = expectedKind
		} else {
			tests[testIndex].Kind = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tests[testIndex].Kind))
		}
		key, err := domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(tests[testIndex].SourceKey)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := rememberTaskTestSourceKey(seen, key); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		tests[testIndex].SourceKey = key

		for groupIndex := range tests[testIndex].Groups {
			key, err := domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(tests[testIndex].Groups[groupIndex].SourceKey)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := rememberTaskTestSourceKey(seen, key); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			tests[testIndex].Groups[groupIndex].SourceKey = key
		}

		for variantIndex := range tests[testIndex].Variants {
			key, err := domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(tests[testIndex].Variants[variantIndex].SourceKey)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := rememberTaskTestSourceKey(seen, key); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			tests[testIndex].Variants[variantIndex].SourceKey = key
			groupKey, err := domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(tests[testIndex].Variants[variantIndex].GroupSourceKey)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			tests[testIndex].Variants[variantIndex].GroupSourceKey = groupKey
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func rememberTaskTestSourceKey(seen map[string]struct{}, key string) error {
	if key == "" {
		return nil
	}
	if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate task test source_key", domain.ErrConflict)
	}
	seen[key] = struct{}{}
	return nil
}

func requestedTaskTypeCode(rawType *string) (int16, error) {
	if rawType == nil {
		return 0, nil
	}
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(*rawType)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return 0, nil
	}
	return domain.ParseTaskType(trimmed)
}

func prepareTaskTests(taskID string, tests []domain.TaskTest) []domain.TaskTest {
	if len(tests) == 0 {
		return nil
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	prepared := make([]domain.TaskTest, 0, len(tests))
	for _, test := range tests {
		item := test
		if strings.TrimSpace(item.ID) == "" {
			item.ID = uuid.NewString()
		}
		item.TaskID = taskID
		item.CreatedAt = now
		item.UpdatedAt = now
		item.Title, item.Description = resolveTaskTestText(item.Translations)

		groupIDs := make(map[string]string, len(item.Groups))
		groups := make([]domain.TaskTestGroup, 0, len(item.Groups))
		for _, group := range item.Groups {
			preparedGroup := group
			if strings.TrimSpace(preparedGroup.ID) == "" {
				preparedGroup.ID = uuid.NewString()
			}
			preparedGroup.TaskTestID = item.ID
			preparedGroup.CreatedAt = now
			preparedGroup.UpdatedAt = now
			preparedGroup.Title = resolveTaskTestGroupTitle(preparedGroup.Translations)
			if preparedGroup.SourceKey != "" {
				groupIDs[preparedGroup.SourceKey] = preparedGroup.ID
			}

			groupTranslations := make([]domain.TaskTestGroupI18n, 0, len(preparedGroup.Translations))
			for _, translation := range preparedGroup.Translations {
				translation.TaskTestGroupID = preparedGroup.ID
				groupTranslations = append(groupTranslations, translation)
			}
			preparedGroup.Translations = groupTranslations
			groups = append(groups, preparedGroup)
		}
		item.Groups = groups

		variants := make([]domain.TaskTestVariant, 0, len(item.Variants))
		for _, variant := range item.Variants {
			preparedVariant := variant
			if strings.TrimSpace(preparedVariant.ID) == "" {
				preparedVariant.ID = uuid.NewString()
			}
			preparedVariant.TaskTestID = item.ID
			if preparedVariant.GroupSourceKey != "" {
				preparedVariant.GroupID = groupIDs[preparedVariant.GroupSourceKey]
			}
			preparedVariant.CreatedAt = now
			preparedVariant.UpdatedAt = now
			preparedVariant.Text = resolveTaskTestVariantText(preparedVariant.Translations)

			variantTranslations := make([]domain.TaskTestVariantI18n, 0, len(preparedVariant.Translations))
			for _, translation := range preparedVariant.Translations {
				translation.TaskTestVariantID = preparedVariant.ID
				variantTranslations = append(variantTranslations, translation)
			}
			preparedVariant.Translations = variantTranslations
			variants = append(variants, preparedVariant)
		}
		item.Variants = variants

		translations := make([]domain.TaskTestI18n, 0, len(item.Translations))
		for _, translation := range item.Translations {
			translation.TaskTestID = item.ID
			translations = append(translations, translation)
		}
		item.Translations = translations

		prepared = append(prepared, item)
	}

	return prepared
}

func resolveTaskTestText(translations []domain.TaskTestI18n) (string, string) {
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(translation.Language), "ru") && strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title) != "" {
			return strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title), strings.TrimSpace(translation.Description)
		}
	}
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(translation.Language), "en") && strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title) != "" {
			return strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title), strings.TrimSpace(translation.Description)
		}
	}
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title) != "" {
			return strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title), strings.TrimSpace(translation.Description)
		}
	}
	return "", ""
}

func resolveTaskTestVariantText(translations []domain.TaskTestVariantI18n) string {
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(translation.Language), "ru") && strings.TrimSpace(translation.Text) != "" {
			return strings.TrimSpace(translation.Text)
		}
	}
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(translation.Language), "en") && strings.TrimSpace(translation.Text) != "" {
			return strings.TrimSpace(translation.Text)
		}
	}
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if strings.TrimSpace(translation.Text) != "" {
			return strings.TrimSpace(translation.Text)
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func resolveTaskTestGroupTitle(translations []domain.TaskTestGroupI18n) string {
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(translation.Language), "ru") && strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title) != "" {
			return strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title)
		}
	}
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(translation.Language), "en") && strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title) != "" {
			return strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title)
		}
	}
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title) != "" {
			return strings.TrimSpace(translation.Title)
		}
	}
	return ""
}
